Chapter 6744: Black Dragon Bloodline

Chapter 6744: Black Dragon Bloodline

“Hmm...” Many thoughts surfaced in her mind.

“I’m sure there are things you haven’t suspected.” He said.

“Such as?” She murmured.

He smiled and didn’t answer directly.

“So let’s go back to your theory, that Skykiller True Dragon’s death is related to Immortal Hunt.” He said.

“Yes, Young Noble. To be more exact, it has to do with the origin of Immortal Hunt, a person who is unknown to all.” Her expression became serious.

“You’ve been thinking about this for quite a bit.” He smiled.

“You share the same belief, Young Noble?” She shuddered.

“Hidden Immortal is the person you’re trying to find.” He said.

“Hidden Immortal... the unimaginable existence of Immortal Hunt.” She murmured.

“And the reason why you are here.” Li Qiye said.

“No, Young Noble. I am here to serve you.” She bowed.

“It’s fine, which is why you handed this bottle over. I don’t mind as long as you are useful.” He waved dismissively before glancing at the bottle: “Where did you get this?”

“Well...” She didn’t answer.

“Then I won’t ask for details, let’s just say you have borrowed it.” He smiled.

“Thank you for understanding.” She bowed.

“Now you can reveal the questions plaguing your mind.” He said.

“I just feel that it’s ominous and want to know more.” She sighed.

“I have no firm opinion before everything is fulfilled. After all, the answer to this secret is privy to one person alone.” He shook his head.

“You knew earlier than I did. Why is that, Young Noble?” She asked.

“As you said, too many coincidences.” He gazed into the distance.

“Just like you and the black dragon, is that another coincidence?” She asked earnestly.

“Hahaha, finally got to the point, what you’re suspicious of.” He laughed.

“I dare not, Young Noble. Although I have always yearned for the stories of the nine worlds and thirteen continents, places blessed with extraordinary talents and determination, I’ve never been there. My knowledge is limited to scattered stories.” She said.

“I’m sure you didn’t hear about the black dragon, that wouldn’t have reached your ears.” He said.

“Yes, Young Noble. I heard about a black dragon entering the mind ocean in Divine Firmament. It is related to Immortal Emperor Min Ren and Guardian.” She said.

“With Min Ren?” He was not surprised to hear this.

“The dragon had the blade of the emperor, overwhelming Divine Firmament.” She said with nothing but respect.

Immortal Emperor Min Ren was a legendary figure in Heaven Realm, daring to challenge Devouring at its peak.

“Strong, but that’s still an exaggeration. The dragon and phoenix might no longer be around but the other divine beasts are just as fierce. Black tortoise, kui niu, kun peng, chongming bird...” He said: “To force its way into the mind ocean will result in grievous injuries or death, not rewards.”

“I’m not clear on this since I only heard it in passing.” She said.

“Yet you are here but that’s fine, everyone has secrets.” He said: “What do you want to know?”

“The black dragon and its bloodline.” She said.

“Why did it travel to the mind ocean?” He smiled.

“Yes, Young Noble.” She said.

“This was a key to how I obtained my freedom. Bloodline...” He said with a hint of emotion.

“Was breaking into the mind ocean your command, Young Noble?” She asked.

“Some things are inevitable at this stage, that’s all. It is a fortune.” He shook his head.

“In theory, it shouldn’t exist in the nine worlds or thirteen continents.” She said.

“In theory, divine bloodlines shouldn’t exist in the mortal world or Demon Beast Epoch.” He responded.

“The black dragon is not from Demon Beast, nor does it possess a faint divine bloodline.” She said confidently.

“Then what are you suspecting?” He sighed.

“I don’t know either.” She let out a sigh: “All of it is merely speculation, no evidence.”

“Perhaps you feel that this black dragon’s bloodline seems similar, potentially connected to Skykiller True Dragon.” He smirked.

“Young Noble, such words shouldn’t be spoken lightly.” She took a deep breath to calm her emotions.

“For you, yes. It’s not forbidden for me.” He smiled.
